prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: proposed website section illustration for Solvero, a business improvement and solution delivery consultancy. Generate a NEW original illustration; the input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Use the same approachable hand-drawn editorial language: slightly irregular black pen outlines, simple adult characters, clean white background, restrained sky blue and muted teal accents with small warm clothing colours. No words, letters, numbers, titles, labels, footnotes, watermarks, logos or pseudo-text. Show a concrete business situation rather than generic technology symbols. No robots, glowing brains, handshakes, stock-photo staging or exaggerated growth graphs. Clean enough to read at a 380px card width. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, high resolution around 1536x1024, generous white margins. Keep important subjects central so a shallow landscape crop does not cut them off. Section: About Solvero. Primary request: show a small client team and a consulting collaborator working together to understand a process and deliver a useful change. Three adult figures around a table: one points to a simple process map of four pictorial steps, another moves an unnecessary detour card aside, the third tests a small working application on a laptop with a plain checkmark. Connect the discovery board and working laptop with a single clear blue curved line. Balanced collaborative scene, characters are conceptual representatives, not portraits or a claim about employee headcount. No software code or detailed dashboards. The scene should communicate investigation leading to implementation, not merely a meeting.
